description: Locked the chest with the second iron.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Asked after the swan, and stayed for the paying.
name: George Bryan

description: Took the week and the five shillings.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Said the sheet will sell, and took fivepence for the quire.
name: John Harrison

description: Paid the week and the five shillings, and wrote the dark.
name: John Heminges

description: Brought the court post with her box.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Offered to keep the sheets, and was refused.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Stood pale, and refused an invented parish.
name: Richard Field

description: Saw the swan down, and asked after the petticoat.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked four or forty, and heard the yard choose.
name: Will Kemp

description: Read the line and did not add a sum.
name: William Shakespeare
